objective: Validate minimal SAME-MAIN full recurring VEVENT self-update, final-writer close semantics, and user-visible bounded-unit trace observability as separate evidence surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: Every scheduler mutation uses the SAME MAIN canonical with full VEVENT DTSTART plus RRULE:FREQ=HOURLY and enabled=true.
The provisional 11-minute (660-second) write is crash insurance only and is superseded on every nonterminal close.
The final close-time RRULE update is the last scheduler mutation of the wake and survives live metadata reread.
CURRENT/ACTIVITY/HANDOFF follow the verified live final due; none may push an older provisional/stale due back to the scheduler.
Durably completed bounded units produce the required compact user-visible completion trace; missing trace is classified as observability failure rather than execution failure.
No new automation, one-shot conversion, dtstart_offset_json, or retired-canonical reactivation occurs.
checkpointable_substeps: Record and verify provisional full-VEVENT RRULE arm.
Advance stale active projections to current authority epoch without using them to drive scheduler.
Record provider delivery offset separately from local schedule mutation correctness.
Validate user-visible trace path against durable bounded-unit evidence.

At nonterminal close, perform final SAME MAIN full-VEVENT RRULE write to observed close + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds), live-verify, then copy due to durable projections without later schedule mutation.
early_finish_fallback: Continue removing stale projection semantics and redundant schedule-control assumptions while preserving minimal live RRULE path and trace evidence.
